Author: CheesyChiz
Name: Stock Manager
Punchline: Balances Island Sanctuary stock with imported Visland routes.
Description: Check Island resources, set stock levels, and let Stock Manager choose imported Visland routes automatically. Supports direct vnavmesh travel, mount selection, flight and tool checks, Lifestream travel, surplus export, and run statistics. Commands: /stockmanager [start|stop|status|travel|emergency|help]. /sm is an alias.
Changelog: Fixed Visland route serialization and direct vnavmesh startup. Added mount selection, closest-waypoint starts, a Settings tab, and clearer Dalamud command descriptions.
